content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HNBGU Field Worker Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HNBGU Field Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the HNBGU Field Worker post is 22 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their application is sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Field Worker posts in HNBGU?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Field Worker post in Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the HNBGU Field Worker position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Field Worker post should not be more than 35 years of age. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Life Science from a recognized University or equivalent. A Master's degree in Life Science and field experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the HNBGU Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Worker post will receive a salary of Rs. 24,000/- per month plus HRA, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for HNBGU Field Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the HNBGU Field Worker recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for HNBGU Field Worker posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the HNBGU Field Worker recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the HNBGU Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Worker post includes shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Final selection will be based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the HNBGU Field Worker post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Field Worker position is Srinagar Garhwal, Uttarakhand, with Pincode 246174, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. When was the HNBGU Field Worker notification released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the HNBGU Field Worker recruitment was released on 14 August 2026. Interested candidates should check the details promptly.
